# People Atlas 0.6.0 — Alpha

> [!WARNING]
> People Atlas 0.6.0 is an alpha version of the plugin. Its fundamental
> behavior is subject to change in future releases.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Compatibility: People Atlas 0.6.0 only supports Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer.
> Obsidian 1.12.x and older are not supported.**

This release adds an explicit partner flow while keeping relationship writes
reviewable and explicit. Publishing People Atlas in the Community Plugins
directory remains a separate step from this GitHub release.

## Changes

- Added the **Partner** Simple relationship shortcut. It stores only the
  explicit neutral `partner`/`partner` role pair and does not change relationship
  types or other metadata.
- After a successful new parent-child relationship, People Atlas can ask whether
  one unique active partner is also a parent of the child.
- **Review relationship** opens the existing relationship editor with the
  partner and child prefilled; only that editor's explicit second **Save** can
  create the second relationship note.
- Ambiguous, ended, multiple, stale, and already-existing candidates remain
  write-free.

## Assets

Install or update the plugin with the attached `main.js`, `manifest.json`, and
`styles.css`.
